summary.nativeWidgetBuild: direct Debug and Release simulator xcodebuild passed; duplicate ExpoWidgetsTarget output issue did not reproduce after single target verification
summary.liquidGlass: centralized tokens and reusable primitives applied only to high-value surfaces

capturePanelVisualResult.contrastChanges: Replaced the shared GlassCard wash on the Capture hero with a purpose-built deep navy/ink material so white text and controls remain crisp.
capturePanelVisualResult.liquidGlassTextureChanges: Added deliberate indigo and rose ambient glows, a top sheen, soft rim stroke, darker lower action layer, and controlled shadow depth without blur-heavy animation or texture images.
capturePanelVisualResult.buttonControlPolish: Reworked the Scan / Upload / Type It In segmented control for stronger active state, readable inactive labels, and matched primary/secondary photo buttons with softer tint instead of a harsh white pill.
capturePanelVisualResult.copyTruthfulnessChanges: Changed the launch subtitle and camera copy to say text/PDF parsing is ready while photo capture is available and OCR review is not enabled in this build.
remainingLimitations: Permission-denied OS prompt state was not separately screenshotted because simulator permission prompts are stateful; the app handles denied permission and the failed/retry state was captured.
No photo OCR claim is made unless the configured OCR parser returns ParsedItems.

cameraCaptureParserResult.scanButton: working native action; requests camera permission, handles denied/cancel/unavailable, creates a ParsedImport from the camera asset, and routes to parser/review or honest failed state
cameraCaptureParserResult.uploadButton: working document-picker action for PDF, text, and image assets; validates type/size, copies to cache, creates ParsedImport, and routes to parser/review or useful error
cameraCaptureParserResult.choosePhotoButton: working media-library action; requests permission, handles cancel/denied, creates ParsedImport, and routes through the same parser contract
cameraCaptureParserResult.typeItIn: working fully local path; validates non-empty text, creates ParsedImport and ParsedItems, then opens Review / Found Work
cameraCaptureParserResult.recentCaptures: uses real ParsedImport records, opens saved parsed rows, displays status/source, and exposes retry on failed imports
cameraCaptureParserResult.retryParse: preserves source metadata and retries failed imports without silently duplicating accepted rows
cameraCaptureParserResult.reviewFoundWork: shows confidence, needsReview, missing-date, duplicate, and parser findings before conversion
cameraCaptureParserResult.addAllAddSelected: Add All is gated by valid, reviewed rows and conversion is idempotent for the same parsed import
cameraCaptureParserResult.ocrTruthfulness: honest fallback; real images/PDFs require configured OCR/text extraction and failed states do not claim assignments were found unless ParsedItems exist
cameraCaptureParserResult.remainingPlatformLimitation: Simulator camera hardware is unavailable by nature; the native camera action handles that as an unavailable state. Production OCR remains dependent on the configured image/OCR parser endpoint.
